name: StepClaw Intercept
description: Forwards before_tool_call events to StepClaw Android for policy evaluation

enabled.description: Enable hook forwarding to StepClaw Android. Omit or true to enable; set false to disable.

promptStats.description: lib/prompt-stats.js only: trace JSON and its console logs, independent of other plugin diagnostics.

enabled.description: Enable prompt-stats (per-trace JSON under logDir). Off unless explicitly set to true together with logDir; trace JSON contains the full prompt.

debug.description: Verbose console logging from prompt-stats only. Off unless explicitly set to true.

logDir.description: Directory for per-trace JSON files. No default: prompt-stats does not write anything unless this is set.
